title: View and Manage AP/AR Data ON shows the Unpaid Invoices, Payments and Credits tabs on a customer
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with Customers View and View and Manage AP/AR Data ON.
custom_steps:
1. Open Customers from the top navigation and open a customer.
  2. Look at the tabs at the top of the customer page.
  3. Look for the Unpaid Invoices, Payments and Credits tabs.
custom_expected: All three tabs (Unpaid Invoices, Payments, Credits) are shown on the customer page.
evidence: UI: role with AP/AR Data ON shows the financial tabs on a customer page — build labels are Invoices / Payments / Deposits (case prose says Unpaid Invoices/Payments/Credits; the AP/AR toggle description uses that wording, actual tab labels are Invoices/Payments/Deposits). Tabs absent when AP/AR off.
